card.name: Hundreds digit in large numbers
card.fires_on: The final zero of a number like 700 or 800, or the word "hundred" after five, when the number is a round count of 500 to 900. It appears in general web text on counts of people, units or objects.

modes.label: Zero ending a round number
modes.description: The last digit 0 in a written figure such as 800 or 900, often followed by thousand, million or a unit.
